1.

Yet there is room! Behold, still open is God’s Father’s bosom, O soul, why dost thou delay? Swiftly flies the time, the day of grace draws to a close; Consider thyself, for now the call goes forth: Yet there is room!

2.

All heaven’s bliss is offered thee now: enter in! O, make haste, for this day alone is thine, Thy day of salvation, when the Lord grants thee time To seek that which belongs to eternal peace. Yet there is room!

3.

All is accomplished; the way is open To the throne of grace: lay thy burden there! There is peace for the soul laden with guilt, An eternal salvation for every slave of sin. Yet there is room!

4.

Soon the door of grace shall close, and if thou then Standest without: no room shall be found. And He who here so gently bids thee: come, Shall then turn thee away to eternal judgment; But now there is room.
